label: There is one and the same being that is God, is the only being to which the…, via classical witness
description: Alternative witness composition: the imported QuartaVia theorem supplies the maximum from its four explicit source premises. Full-description naming and the eight pointwise attribute proofs apply to this same maximum; GodIsOne still uses the explicit GodIsMaximalInBeing premise. No First-Way motion, regress, particular excluded-middle or created-agent-identification hypothesis is used. All remaining philosophical premises are open; no source premise is proved by omitting it from this alternative.
